text:
Here’s your reminder to look for the ecstatic in the prosaic, no matter where life takes you.

The server at Huong Viet wasted no time ushering me to a booth that would have comfortably seated a family of four. I was dining alone, paying my respects to this Vietnamese institution for the first time in many years. I hadn’t really planned this lunchtime trip to the Eden Center in Falls Church. It just fell into place through a process of elimination.
